llm_response.reason: The website displays characteristic signs of a scam: it mimics the legitimate Lacoste brand name and products but is not an authorized retailer and uses its own domain; the copyright suggests ownership by irinarossi.shop rather than Lacoste; there is no company information or verified contact details; dedicated privacy policy and payment information pages are missing; and hyperlinks only lead to product or account pages. All patterns fit well-known fake shopping scam techniques.
